when: event.text:find('Objective: Eliminate specified enemy', 1, true) or event.text:find('Objective: Eliminate specified enemies', 1, true) or event.text:find('Objective: Eliminate all enemies', 1, true) or event.text:find('Objective: Eliminate enemy leader', 1, true) or event.text:find('Objective: Activate all lamps', 1, true)
event.text:lower():find('avoid discovery by archaic gears', 1, true) or event.text:lower():find('do not destroy archaic gears', 1, true)
commands: setSessionVar('nyzul.restriction', event.text:lower():find('do not destroy archaic gears', 1, true) and 'Do not destroy archaic gears!' or 'Avoid discovery by archaic gears!')

when: event.text:find('activated in a specific order', 1, true)
commands: setSessionVar('nyzul.objective', 'Objective: Activate all lamps in a specific order.')

when: event.text:find('all other lamps are activated at the same time', 1, true)
commands: setSessionVar('nyzul.objective', 'Objective: Activate all lamps at the same time.')

when: event.text:find('certification code has been registered', 1, true)
commands: setSessionVar('nyzul.objective', 'Objective: Activate all lamps by registering certification codes.')

when: event.text:lower():find('time remaining:', 1, true) or (event.text:lower():find('you have ', 1, true) and event.text:lower():find('(earth time) to complete this mission.', 1, true))
commands: setSessionVar('nyzul.time_remaining_until', event.time + number(event.text:match('[Tt]ime [Rr]emaining:%s*(%d+)') or event.text:match('[Yy]ou have%s+(%d+)'), 0) * (event.text:lower():find('minute', 1, true) and 60 or 1))
